summary: Text typed before hydration survives in every engine, including keys pressed while hydration lands. Fix-up (D251, refines D226): RHF forms (InquiryForm, MechanicRegistrationForm) spread keep(register(name)) from useKeepTypedBeforeHydration (components/ui/Field.tsx) — the wrapped ref reads the DOM value in the hydration commit right before RHF writes the default, and the form layout effect (after its useWatch calls) restores it with setValue and renders once more before paint. Textarea derives its counter from the element on every commit, so values written by register() defaults, setValue (the restore) or reset are counted (/upit Opis shows 25 / 2.000 after restore, 22 / 2.000 for ?q= prefill). Controlled inputs (SearchBox, sign-up, reset, back-in-stock) keep adopting the DOM value in a mount layout effect (they already read at commit). SearchBox props API unchanged. Checkout is client-only, nothing to preserve.
